query:
-- Find duplicates first
SELECT projectId, tagId, COUNT(*) as count
FROM projectTags
GROUP BY projectId, tagId
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

-- Delete duplicates, keeping only one of each
DELETE t1 FROM projectTags t1
INNER JOIN projectTags t2 
WHERE t1.id > t2.id 
AND t1.projectId = t2.projectId 
AND t1.tagId = t2.tagId;
